lessons.title: Say the three sentences
lessons.content:
# Say the three sentences

This is the last Intermediate course. It is not a victory lap and it is not a hymn. It is the course where the brand you have been walking past for weeks becomes three sentences you can say without shaking.

## Sentence 1 — the token

Crystal Stones is a **BEP-20 token on BNB Smart Chain**. Chain ID **56**. The public contract this academy teaches you to verify is:

`0xe252FCb1Aa2E0876E9B5f3eD1e15B9b4d11A0b00`

That string is a program plus a list of balances. It is not a vault of rocks. It is not an invoice. It is not gas. Gas on BSC is **BNB**. Sending CST to that contract is not “depositing into the project.

## Sentence 2 — the school

**Crystal Web3 Academy** (Crystal Stones Academy in older copy) is a school. Basic is free. Intermediate is a paid track at ** Advanced is labelled for later. Lessons, quizzes, ranks, Mentor, certificates. Certificates are academic. They are not mineral title, not equity, not a warehouse receipt.

The school will not tell you to buy the token. A school that required the mascot ticker to learn would be a sales room.

## Sentence 3 — the backing claim

The project describes itself as a Real World Asset effort: **tangible assets, primarily solid minerals, with additional language about real estate and petroleum**. In RWA Specialization you learned the four drawers. Here we keep the claim in the claim drawer. This course will not fake a vault tour. It will teach you what would count as evidence, and what is only a shared logo.

TABLE
Sentence | Object | Common mash-up
1 Token | BEP-20 on BSC at the named address | “The contract is the mine”

3 Claim | Minerals / property / petroleum as words that want proof | “The academy proved the mine”
ENDTABLE

## Why a school shares a brand with a token

Sponsors fund education because they want literate users, or because they want a marketing funnel, or both. Your job is not to psychoanalyze them. Your job is to **use the school as a school**. Literacy includes: you can hold zero CST and still finish Intermediate. That is a feature.

## Worked scenario

A cousin says, “You study there, so it must be backed.” You say the three sentences. You add: I have not been to a warehouse. The explorer showed me a token. If they wanted a hymn, they came to the wrong graduate.

DIAGRAM
CRYSTAL STONES (name)
   |-- BEP-20 list
   |-- Academy (this product)
   |-- Backing claim (off-chain homework)
Arrows between them are optional, documented, or imaginary. Grade which.
ENDDIAGRAM

NOTE
If you cannot say the three sentences without the word “community,” start this lesson again. Community is a chat. It is not a fourth sentence.
ENDNOTE

## Five layers, not one slogan

The PDF standard for this course is layers. Draw them. Do not mash them.

**Layer A — The token.** A BEP-20 on BNB Smart Chain with a published tax and burn design. This is the only layer you can inspect on-chain today without asking anyone for permission. Contract `0xe252FCb1Aa2E0876E9B5f3eD1e15B9b4d11A0b00`. Chain ID 56. Decimals 18. Public name/symbol on crystalstones.org: CRYSTAL STONES.

**Layer B — The RWA thesis.** The site states the token is an RWA powered by tangible physical assets: primarily solid minerals (gold, lithium and more), with additional exposure to real estate and petroleum. That is the economic story. Whether it is a completed legal structure is the subject of the RWA course. Do not assume it here.

**Layer C — Live utility.** Crystal Web3 Academy is listed as a live utility: education on Web3, RWA, blockchain, and the decentralized economy. This layer does not need a mining licence to function.

**Layer D — Roadmap utility.** Phase 3–4 on the site: CEX listings and a Crystal Stones CEX “incoming,” partnerships with mineral and energy enterprises, charity outreach, later a Crystal Stones Chain. Teach these as planned, not as live venues.

**Layer E — Public trust signals.** Vital Block smart-contract audit (GitHub and GitLab mirrors linked from the site). Listings: CoinMarketCap, CoinGecko, DexScreener, AVE.ai (listed and KYC’d). Verified X @crystalstones01. These raise discoverability and code-review surface. They do not mint a lithium tonne.

TABLE
Item | Public value
Network | BNB Smart Chain (BEP-20), chain ID 56
Token name / symbol | CRYSTAL STONES / CRYSTAL STONES
Decimals | 18
Contract | `0xe252FCb1Aa2E0876E9B5f3eD1e15B9b4d11A0b00`
PancakeSwap v2 pair (WBNB) | `0x52bF227C8D43026697FA5Fa6Cd4a81C446977130`
Official site | crystalstones.org
Academy | crystalweb3academy.org
Official X | @crystalstones01
ENDTABLE

Hard rule for the whole course: homepage adjectives are claims. Contract, taxes, pair, and audit links are checkable objects. Keep the two piles separate. If a chat, ad, or lookalike shows a different contract, you stop.

## Mission language to teach, not to recite as proof

The site’s mission: bridge blockchain and physical natural resources; empower miners and stakeholders; maximize resource value through research and chain integration; turn raw earthly assets into tokenized access; channel natural wealth into blockchain applications. Beyond RWA, the token is described as the native token of a forthcoming CEX. Quote it. Do not treat the paragraph as a reserve letter.

DIAGRAM
A token (on-chain today)
B RWA thesis (claim until papers)
C academy (live utility)
D CEX / chain / partnerships (roadmap)
E listings + code audit (discoverability, not tonnes)
ENDDIAGRAM

lessons.title: Official rooms versus lookalikes
lessons.content:
# Official rooms versus lookalikes

A global project will be impersonated. That is not a maybe. This lesson is how you bookmark on a calm day so a loud day does not own you.

## Surfaces this academy has pointed you at

- The academy application you are in now (your bookmarked URL).
- Public project communications that you typed yourself from a calm bookmark: for example crystalstones.org, the project’s X account, a public Telegram. **You** must confirm those bookmarks against packaging you already trust — packaging, not a Google ad, not a Discord stranger.

This lesson will not chase every URL change in 2026. URLs move. The **method** does not: type it, bookmark it, do not switch because a mention looked urgent.

## What rooms are

Telegram and X are loudspeakers and group chats. They are good at announcements and bad at custody. An admin badge is a setting. It is not a registrar. Anyone can clone an avatar.

Never: seed, 2FA, remote desktop, “support will whitelist you,” CST to a pasted 0x, “new academy domain, migrate today.”

 Status moves as the payment processor reports it.

The token contract is not that address.

## Worked scenario

You get a Telegram DM with a crystal logo: “KYC for RWA holders, connect here.” Official school KYC for studying is your account email, not a random Web3 connect. You do not connect. You open your bookmarked academy. If the academy did not ask, nobody asked.

DIAGRAM
CALM DAY: type URL --> bookmark --> done
LOUD DAY: mention --> ad --> DM --> clone
Use only the calm-day bookmark. The loud day is the exam.
ENDDIAGRAM

NOTE
Academy staff do not cold-DM invoices. Orders are on the site, per user, per payment.
ENDNOTE

## Official identifiers you type yourself

crystalstones.org. crystalweb3academy.org. @crystalstones01. info@crystalstones.org. t.me/crystalstones. discord.gg/crystalstones. You type them. You bookmark them on a calm day. You do not switch because a mention looked urgent. URLs move; the method does not.

Telegram and X are loudspeakers. An admin badge is a setting. Anyone can clone an avatar. Rooms are good at announcements and bad at custody.

Support on the site will not DM first asking for a seed, a “release fee,” or a wallet connect to “see backing.” Poisoned swap links sit under official posts. Defense: type pancakeswap.finance yourself or use the link on crystalstones.org.

DIAGRAM
CALM DAY: type URL --> bookmark
LOUD DAY: ad, GIF, DM, clone
Use only the calm-day bookmark.
ENDDIAGRAM

lessons.content:
# The academy as a product

You have used most of this already. Now name it like an engineer, so impersonators cannot invent extra organs.

## Tracks

- **Basic** — free. Foundations, wallets, first buy concepts, BSC, scams.
- **Intermediate** — paid bundle, ** You may skip Basic if you already have that literacy. Modules still unlock in sequence *inside* a course unless an admin previewed your account.
- **Advanced** — labelled coming later. Videos the client has not shipped are not secretly hiding in CST.

Payment unlocks the **Intermediate track**, not a single PDF. That is why the catalogue can still show sequence locks between courses until each prior course is complete — product design, not a mineral ritual.

## Mentor

Crystal Mentor is a tutoring layer over lesson text plus a hosted model. It is not a price oracle, not a broker, not “the team.” If it ever sounds like a buy order, you treat that as a model mistake and you do not obey it with a wallet. The empty-state brain animation is decoration. The never-list is not.

## Ranks and XP

Ranks move with study: modules, quizzes, streaks — as the dashboard computes. There is no “rank contract” you must fund. Anyone who sells ranks for CST is not the academy.

## Certificates

When a **track** is complete under the rules, you can preview and print. The QR / verify link must point at the **live academy origin**, not `localhost`. Names on the certificate come from your profile, not from a wallet ENS. A certificate is not a mining licence.

USDT, BEP-20, BSC, $10, order-specific address, stay on the page while status moves, receipt when paid. Brother’s wallet is fine **if** they pay the address that belongs to **your** order. The school does not need CST to notice USDT.

TABLE
Organ | Stores | Does not store
Account | Email, progress, role | Your seed
Mentor | Chat threads, lesson snippets | Authority to trade
Rank | XP arithmetic | On-chain balance
Certificate | Name, track, date, verify URL | Title to land
Order | USDT invoice, status | CST
ENDTABLE

## Worked scenario

Dashboard shows Adept. A site says “mint Adept NFT with CST to keep it.” Ranks are in our database. You do not mint. You screenshot nothing into a connect-wallet page.

DIAGRAM
TRACKS --> lessons --> quizzes --> XP --> rank
                 \--> track complete --> certificate

ENDDIAGRAM

NOTE
Admin role is a database flag plus extra login friction. It is not sold in CST. /admin is 404 to learners on purpose.
ENDNOTE

## Layer C, named like an engineer

Crystal Web3 Academy is the live utility in the public ecosystem. Basic is literacy. Intermediate is methods, including RWA Specialization and this ecosystem course. Advanced is labelled for later and is not secretly hiding in a ticker.

Tracks, Mentor, ranks, certificates are school organs. Mentor is a tutoring layer over lesson text. It is not a price oracle and not a dealing desk. Ranks move with study arithmetic. Certificates are academic records. They are not mineral title.

## How the two academy courses fit

TABLE
Question | This ecosystem course | RWA course
What is the token and how do I not get phished? | Yes | No
What do 3% / 6% / 0.2% do to a swap? | Yes | Only as market-structure risk
Are minerals, land, petroleum legally behind the token? | Names the sleeves; points to RWA | Full lifecycle and DD memo
Should you buy? | Neither course answers | Neither course answers
ENDTABLE

This course teaches how the Crystal Stones system is built and how you interact with it safely, using public materials on crystalstones.org. The RWA course teaches how to judge a claim. Do not duplicate the whole RWA document list here. Point at it.

# Why this course exists in Intermediate

Without this course, literate learners still mash the logo. With it, you can work at another company tomorrow and still not send keys to a crystal avatar.

## The paragraph

 That is the course.

## What would make this a bad course

A list of price targets. A promise that minerals pay the token. A requirement to hold CST. Repeated “global check” filler instead of mechanisms. You called that out on earlier drafts. This version is mechanisms.

## Worked scenario

You apply for a job. They ask what you know about Crystal Stones. You do not say “it will run.” You say “I can audit a mash-up.” That is employable. Hymns are not.

DIAGRAM

not --> inventory of rocks
not --> a private placement
ENDDIAGRAM

NOTE
If a future marketing page contradicts this paragraph, the paragraph wins inside this school.
ENDNOTE

## Companion, not a hymn

Without this course, literate learners still mash the logo. With it, you can describe layers A–E, read the published tokenomics table, walk a mechanical swap path without pasting a poisoned contract, and hold this specific BEP-20 without the failure modes tax tokens attract.

The $10 worth of Intermediate is methods, not ore delivery. This course’s slice of that is: identifiers, taxes as wallet arithmetic, sleeves named and unfinished, a threat model for this ticker. No price target. No hold requirement. “How to buy” later means the mechanical path if you already decided to interact. It is not a recommendation.

DIAGRAM

Ecosystem course: how this system is built and how not to get phished
Neither: buy or sell

lessons.content:
# The address, character by character

Most losses in “official contract” stories are **lookalikes**, not philosophy.

## How lookalikes work

A scammer deploys a token with the same name and a similar 0x. Ads sit above explorers. Chat pastes a Unicode homoglyph. You are tired. You copy from the chat.

Defence: paper, or a bookmark of the explorer page you opened from documentation you already trust. Compare in chunks: `0xe252` `FCb1` `Aa2E` `0876` `E9B5` `f3eD` `1e15` `B9b4` `d11A` `0b00`.

## What the address is not

Not Ethereum. Not a payment address for the school. Not a place to “stake academy XP.” Not a burn destination you must use as homework.

## Worked scenario

You type the address into a notes file titled “verify-only.” You never paste from Telegram into the send field. If you must send CST for your own reasons, that is not this homework. This homework is reading.

DIAGRAM
PAPER ADDRESS --> explorer search (bookmark)
CHAT ADDRESS --> assume hostile
ENDDIAGRAM

NOTE
If a page asks you to pay the contract to “activate Intermediate,” it has already failed this lesson.
ENDNOTE

## Official contract and pair

Memorize and verify on BscScan before any swap.

Contract: `0xe252FCb1Aa2E0876E9B5f3eD1e15B9b4d11A0b00`

Chunks: `0xe252` `FCb1` `Aa2E` `0876` `E9B5` `f3eD` `1e15` `B9b4` `d11A` `0b00`. First six and last four out loud: 0xe252FC…0b00.

PancakeSwap v2 pair (CRYSTAL STONES / WBNB): `0x52bF227C8D43026697FA5Fa6Cd4a81C446977130`

Not Ethereum. Not Base. Not a payment address for a school invoice. Not a place to “stake academy XP.” Lookalikes deploy the same name and a similar 0x. Ads sit above explorers. Chat pastes a homoglyph. Defence: paper you wrote, or a bookmark of the explorer page you opened from crystalstones.org.

The 44% “migrated tokens” allocation line is why scammers keep old addresses in circulation. Official contract is only the one on crystalstones.org and the verified socials.

lessons.title: Explorer path without a wallet connection
lessons.content:
# Explorer path without a wallet connection

BscScan is the common explorer for this book. Bookmark it. Search ads clone it.

## The path

1. Confirm you are on mainnet, not a testnet explorer.
2. Paste the official address from paper.
3. Token tab: name, symbol, decimals, supply.
4. Contract tab: verified source or not. Verified = compiler match. Not an audit, not “safe.”
5. Read contract: `totalSupply`, `balanceOf` of an address you care about, `owner` if present.
6. Write contract: this is live sending. Not homework.
7. Holders: who has how much.
8. Close.

If a clone says “connect to prove you are human,” it is not an explorer. It is a drainer.

## Dates

Write `totalSupply` with today’s date. This course may mention older public figures (~135,000,000 total, ~104,100,000 circulating). Those are **historical marketing numbers** until they match what you just read. Methods over memory.

## Worked scenario

Supply on a 2024 infographic disagrees with the read function today. You do not argue in a group. You trust the function for the token drawer. You still have no mine.

DIAGRAM
BOOKMARK BSCSCAN --> paper 0x --> READ --> date-stamp --> close
Write tab stays closed for class.
ENDDIAGRAM

NOTE
Verified source helps you read mint/pause/tax. It does not help you see a quarry.
ENDNOTE

## Read path (no signature)

1. Mainnet BscScan, not a testnet clone, not a Google ad. 2. Paste `0xe252FCb1Aa2E0876E9B5f3eD1e15B9b4d11A0b00` from paper. 3. Token tab: name, symbol, decimals, supply. 4. Contract tab: verified source = compiler match, not an audit. 5. Read: totalSupply, owner if present, tax getters if present. 6. Write tab stays closed for class. 7. Holders. 8. Close.

If a clone says “connect to prove you are human,” it is a drainer.

Date-stamp totalSupply. Site figures as of September 2026: total 135,000,000; circulating about 104,100,000. Those are published numbers until they match what you just read. Methods over memory.

Vital Block belongs here as a **code** document. CMC belongs as discoverability. Neither is a tonne.

lessons.title: Owner, mint, pause, tax — control is a person
lessons.content:
# Owner, mint, pause, tax — control is a person

Tokenomics class taught the catalogue. Here we attach it to **this** ticker’s homework: you will look, you will not take our word for a function list that can change.

## Questions for verified source

- Is there `Ownable` or an access-control role?
- Can `mint` still run? From which address?
- Is there a proxy? Who is the admin of the proxy?
- `pause` / `blacklist` / `excludeFromFee`?
- Can a tax be changed after listing?
- Is there a `burn` or a dead-address convention?

Write yes/no with the date. If source is unverified, write “cannot read; extra risk.” Do not invent a mineral explanation for an owner mint. Mint is mint.

## Renounce

Renounce means the owner function was called and the owner is the zero address — **if** that is what happened, **if** there is no hidden admin, **if** there is no proxy. People screenshot the word. You screenshot the owner() result.

## Why RWA claims make control scarier

If the story is “token equals rocks,” then a pause is a door on the **list**, not on the rocks. Holders feel the door. Rocks, if any, do not.

## Worked scenario

Owner can mint. Chat says “they mint only to match new ore.” That is a story. Matching would require a public reconciliation: ore in, tokens out, third party. Without it, you have an owner mint plus a story. Grade separately.

DIAGRAM
KEY --> mint/pause/tax
KEY -/-> warehouse (unless a document says so, and you have the document)
ENDDIAGRAM

NOTE
 You will dump it live on the explorer.
ENDNOTE

## Published control claims, then check

crystalstones.org states the contract is renounced and liquidity is locked. Renounce means the owner key is supposed to be gone, so tax parameters should not keep moving. Lock means LP tokens are time-locked or sent to a locker. Both are checkable on-chain. The lesson sends you to BscScan or the locker UI rather than the word on a landing page. A third-party scanner snapshot around this date has shown buy tax 3% / sell tax 6% consistent with the site.

Questions for verified source: Ownable or roles? Can mint still run? Proxy admin? pause / blacklist / excludeFromFee? Can tax change after listing? Burn or dead-address convention?

If the story is “token equals rocks,” a pause is a door on the **list**, not on the rocks. Grade control and claims in separate drawers.

lessons.title: Holders, “locked,” and circulating stories
lessons.content:
# Holders, “locked,” and circulating stories

Circulating supply is the most abused integer after price.

## Method

1. `totalSupply` today.
2. Top holders.
3. For each labelled lock, team, “ecosystem,” dead: can it `transfer`?
4. Subtract only what **cannot** move, or subtract nothing and show your working.
5. Date-stamp.

If a labelled lock moves, the old circulating number was theatre. You do not need to shout. You update the memo.

## Dead addresses

Sending to a well-known burn address can be a burn. Sending to a random EOA the team still controls is not a burn. Read.

## DEX pairs

Pair contracts holding tokens are inventory for a market, not “locked community treasure” unless a locker contract with a timed unlock says so. Locker contracts can still be scam lockers. Read the locker.

## Crystal Stones homework

Do this on the official address. This lesson will not print a holder table that is wrong next month. The skill is the table you build.

## Worked scenario

Banner: 104.1 million circulating. You find a “team” wallet that transferred yesterday. You refuse the banner. You still do not trade. You have a better integer, not a prophecy.

DIAGRAM
totalSupply
  - burned (true dead)
  - time-locked (contract that actually cannot pay until T)
  - ??? team (if it can move, do not subtract)
= circulating you are willing to write
ENDDIAGRAM

NOTE
A pie chart without addresses is a drawing. Demand addresses.
ENDNOTE

## Circulating versus locked versus labelled

Site circulating ~104.1 million of 135 million. Allocation pie is a different object (next module). “Locked” on a dashboard is a caption until the locker address and unlock date are public. A labelled wallet that can still transfer is not locked. Watch one. Date the observation.

Top holders: contracts versus EOAs versus dead. Pair `{PAIR}` should appear as the pool, not as “the mine.”

lessons.title: Deflation as a net, not a mood
lessons.content:
# Deflation as a net, not a mood

“Burns on transfers” is a slogan until you measure mint versus burn over time.

## The inequality

If burned (and truly dead) over period T **exceeds** minted over T, supply fell. If mint > burn, the story is inflation with a burn animation. If both are tiny, you have a normal list.

Read events or supply snapshots at two dates. Arithmetic. No soundtrack.

## Taxes

A transfer tax that burns a slice can also send a slice to an EOA. That EOA is a person. A 99% tax is a trap, not a “commitment to deflation.” Tokenomics course already covered this. Here you look for the setters: can someone turn the tax after you arrive?

## Worked scenario

Marketing: deflationary. You see owner mint of a large amount last month and a 1% burn. Net is up. You write “net inflation in T.” You do not owe the chat an argument.

DIAGRAM
MINT volume  vs  BURN volume   in the same window
The larger one names the period. Slogans do not.
ENDDIAGRAM

NOTE
Deflation does not imply price. Price is a market. This school does not forecast it.
ENDNOTE

## Live burn versus “total burnt 22%”

Two different ideas. Live burn: a slice of a buy (site: 0.2%) sent to a dead address, reducing circulating supply over time **if volume exists**. Allocation burnt: a historical or structural line in the tokenomics pie (site: 22%). Do not add those two numbers together as if they were the same event.

Taxes and burns do not create a mining licence. They do not raise the grade of a lithium deposit. They only shape the BEP-20 market machine (Layer 1 in the RWA course). Keep that sentence so the two courses lock together.

lessons.title: Allocations, unlocks, and labelled wallets
lessons.content:
# Allocations, unlocks, and labelled wallets

A pie without addresses is art class.

## Unlocks

An unlock is **the moment those tokens can move**. It is not a legal requirement to sell. It is not a guaranteed dump. It is not “price must fall.” It is inventory that became liquid. Markets may ignore it. Markets may not.

Time-lock contracts can be real. They can also be fake lockers. Read `release` conditions.

## Team wallets that are EOAs

If “vesting” is just a labelled EOA, a person can move tokens now. That is not vesting. Vesting is a program or a legal escrow that actually restrains.

## Worked scenario

Pie: 20% team, 10% liquidity, 70% community. No addresses. You treat it as a drawing. Crystal Stones materials you find in the wild get the same treatment until mapped.

DIAGRAM
SLICE --> ADDRESS --> CAN IT MOVE NOW?
If any arrow is missing, stop quoting percentages.
ENDDIAGRAM

NOTE
Community is not an address. Neither is “ecosystem.”
ENDNOTE

## Published allocation lines (not live swap fees)

TABLE
Line | Published figure
Total burnt (allocation) | 22%
Liquidity (allocation) | 24%
Migrated tokens | 44%
Marketing | 5%
Staking reward | 4%
Community airdrop | 1%
ENDTABLE

Allocation lines are not the same object as live swap taxes (3% buy / 6% sell / 0.2% buy burn). “Migrated tokens 44%” is a history flag. A migration means an older contract or distribution was moved. Scammers keep the old contract alive in chats. Official contract is only the current one.

Do not treat the pie as a vault schedule. It is a distribution story. Date it. Re-read holders when you care.

lessons.title: The $10 — the only official price in this building
lessons.content:
# The $10 — the only official price in this building

Intermediate costs **ten US dollars**, paid in **USDT on BNB Smart Chain (BEP-20)**, created as an **order** on

 Internally, engineering may use a processor. Learners see:

## What you see

Amount, network warning, order address, QR optional, status. Pay from any wallet — including a relative’s — **as long as the destination is this order’s address** and the asset/network match. Status to paid unlocks the track. Receipt prints when paid, not while pending, not while expired unless policy says the processor still credited you.

## What you never see

- CST as tuition.
- The token contract as pay-to.
- A Telegram 0x.
- Staff asking you to “top up gas in CST.”
- A second invoice in DMs.

## Expired invoices

If you paid the expired address, that is a processor / timing problem, not a reason to send a second payment to a helpful stranger. Support with **transaction hash**, on the academy, not in a cloned group.

## Worked scenario

Phone wallet: USDT, BSC, paste order address, send exact amount. You wait on the page. You do not spam extra tokens. You do not switch to CST “because it is cheaper.” Cheaper is how people pay the wrong rail.

DIAGRAM
ORDER id --> USDT BEP-20 --> order address --> status paid --> track access
Anything else is a different movie.
ENDDIAGRAM

NOTE
Public pages say “ Vendor names leak into phishing scripts.
ENDNOTE

## This course does not publish a token price

Numbers on DEX screens change. The method does not. Neither this course nor the RWA course answers “should you buy.” “How to buy” in the next stretch means the mechanical path on BNB Smart Chain if you already decided to interact. Size, target, and timing are not curriculum.

## Haircut stack (wallet arithmetic, not a pitch)

Taxes are taken from the transfer, not from “the chart.” If you spend 1 BNB of value on a buy, you do not receive 1 BNB of tokens at mid price. Slippage, pool impact, the 3% tax, and the 0.2% buy burn all sit between the button and the balance. If you sell, the 6% tax plus pool impact sit between your token balance and the BNB that arrives.

Worked scenario: plan a 100 USDT-equivalent buy and a later full sell. Write the haircut stack: buy tax, buy burn, pool impact in, pool impact out, sell tax, gas. You will not get a precise number without a quote. You will stop being surprised that “in” and “out” are not mirrors.

Set slippage above the tax or the swap reverts. A common failure: 0.5% slippage on a 3% tax token. The transaction fails; they think the token is “broken.” It is not. The router cannot complete inside that tolerance. Students often start around 6–8% and tighten after a successful quote — reason, not a magic number.

lessons.title: The school is not a DEX and not a vault
lessons.content:
# The school is not a DEX and not a vault

This sounds obvious until a landing page puts a chart next to a lesson.

## DEX

A pool is a contract that makes two lists interchangeable at a price. It does not grade your brain teaser. It does not custody ore. Liquidity can be pulled. Price can be thin. None of that is Intermediate.

## Vault

A vault holds objects. This academy holds **rows in a database**: users, progress, orders. If someone says “the academy vaults the minerals,” they have mashed rails. RWA Specialization already refused that mash. This lesson refuses it again because it will come back in group chats.

## Worked scenario

A banner: “Learn and earn CST.” Official lessons do not pay CST. If a campaign ever does, it would be written on the academy site as a campaign, with a wallet you do not have to seed-share. Default: no earn. Study.

DIAGRAM
DEX pool | Academy DB | Warehouse
three buildings. one logo is not architecture.
ENDDIAGRAM

NOTE
“Powered by Crystal Stones” on the footer is attribution. It is not a pool or a vault.
ENDNOTE

## Three machines, still

Layer A is a DEX-tradable BEP-20 (live path: wallet → BNB → PancakeSwap, plus the on-site swap widget; Transak shown as a fiat card path into the same destination). Layer B is an RWA thesis until papers. Layer C is a school. A certificate does not route a swap. A swap does not complete a lesson. A listing does not title a pit.

lessons.title: How to quote a claim
lessons.content:
# How to quote a claim

Write the project’s words in quotation marks. Then write your questions. Do not upgrade the words.

## The words, as this academy has taught them

The project describes backing by tangible assets, **primarily solid minerals**, with **additional exposure to real estate and petroleum**.

That is the quote. Not “the mine is proven.” Not “nothing is there.” Both upgrades are unpaid jobs.

## Questions that follow any such quote

Where, whose name, encumbrance, inspection, insolvency, redemption. RWA course already gave you the memo. Copy the questions here onto Crystal Stones stationery. Fill only from sources you can point at.

## Worked scenario

A video says “petroleum upside.” You add a line: *claim: petroleum exposure; evidence in materials I have: none yet.* You do not start a fight under the video. You have a notes file.

DIAGRAM
QUOTE --> QUESTIONS --> EVIDENCE OR BLANK
Skipping to “backed!” or “scam!” is the same sin: skipping.
ENDDIAGRAM

NOTE
This school’s grading rewards blanks. It does not reward dunking.
ENDNOTE

## What crystalstones.org actually says (September 2026)

Primary sleeve: solid minerals — gold, lithium, and more. Additional sleeves: real estate and petroleum. Differentiation claim: most commodity tokens stop at vaulted gold; this project aims at an underserved mineral frontier on BNB Chain, with a deflationary token tied to industrial utility. Geographic overlay: Africa’s critical-mineral endowment as the long-horizon story. Partnership language on the roadmap: local and foreign mineral and energy enterprises (Phase 3).

Quote the site. Then ask evidence questions. Do not upgrade adjectives to proven. Do not prosecute without a file.

The sentence you must be able to write: Crystal Stones names three RWA sleeves on crystalstones.org. Naming a sleeve is the start of an RWA design, not the finish. Finish looks like title, vehicle, custodian, attestation, and a redemption or distribution rule. Point at RWA Modules 2 and 4 for the document list. Do not duplicate that whole course here.

lessons.title: Minerals at receipt standard
lessons.content:
# Minerals at receipt standard

If Crystal Stones ever publishes warehouse receipts, assays, and a wrapper name, you will know how to read them because of RWA Specialization. Until then, you do not lower the standard because you like the logo.

## Receipt standard

Named warehouse or titled stockpile. Quantity. Quality (assay). Date. Legal owner = wrapper. Insurance mentioned with a real policy or honestly omitted. Reconciliation to token supply if they claim 1:1 or any ratio.

In-ground resources **fail** this standard on purpose. They might still be a mining company story. Mining company stories are not receipts.

## Worked scenario

An infographic: “X tonnes backing each token.” No warehouse, no assay date, no ratio policy for mint. You write *fails receipt standard.* You do not write *worth zero.* You are not a pricing engine.

DIAGRAM
RECEIPT STANDARD
 warehouse + assay + date + wrapper + (optional) ratio policy
Logo does not substitute any box.
ENDDIAGRAM

NOTE
Lowering the standard for “our” ticker is how literate people still get got.
ENDNOTE

## Legal object, not a mood

Possible completed forms: allocated vaulted metal; a royalty or stream on a named concession; equity in an operating company; an offtake. Incomplete form: “minerals” with no cadastre extract, no reserve letter, no SPV. Gold-in-a-vault and lithium-in-the-ground are not the same instrument. Vaulted gold is easier to attest because it is already global, fungible, vaulted, and legally familiar. In-ground lithium is a classified right in a host cadastre plus a model.

“Africa has minerals” is a real macro fact. It does not by itself put those tonnes behind this BEP-20.

lessons.title: Property and petroleum in one pass
lessons.content:
# Property and petroleum in one pass

Additional exposure. Additional **homework**, not additional faith.

## Property minimum

Title number, wrapper as owner or lessee, debt schedule, what cash flow if any, who decides repairs. A skyline photo is not a minimum.

## Petroleum minimum

Working interest or royalty or tank inventory — named. Quality specs if inventory. Offtake if they claim flows. Reservoir-in-the-ground is the mineral in-ground problem again.

## Worked scenario

A slide with three icons: gem, house, flame. You make three lines of blanks. Icons are not objects.

DIAGRAM
ICON ROW --> three memos or three blanks
Never one memo for three icons.
ENDDIAGRAM

NOTE
“Diversified RWA” is a slogan until each icon has a memo.
ENDNOTE

## Two additional sleeves

Real estate. Possible completed form: shares in an SPV that holds a titled property, plus a manager and a rent waterfall. Incomplete form: “exposure to real estate.”

Petroleum. Possible completed forms: royalty on producing wells, working interest, offtake. Incomplete form: “petroleum exposure” that tracks oil price in the reader’s head but not in a contract. Do not flatten petroleum into an oil-price token.

If no rent or royalty ever hits a public wallet, that sleeve is not live as cash flow. Three icons on a slide become three memos or three blanks. Never one memo for three icons.

lessons.title: What BSC will never know
lessons.content:
# What BSC will never know

Learners keep hoping a clever contract will see a mine. It will not.

## What BSC knows

Transactions, state of programs, your CST balance if you hold any, USDT transfers to an invoice, gas paid in BNB.

## What it does not know

Grade of ore, honesty of an assay, a judge’s order, a tenant, a pipeline, whether a PDF was true on Thursday.

Oracles can import a number. The number’s quality is the oracle’s quality. If the oracle is the team, you have a blog with extra steps.

## Worked scenario

Someone proposes “put the mine on-chain.” You ask which of the unknown things became a sensor. If none, they meant “put a picture on IPFS.” Fine as art. Not as a vault.

DIAGRAM
SENSORS / COURTS / LABS --> (human process) --> maybe an oracle --> chain
Skipping to the last box is a startup deck.
ENDDIAGRAM

## Chain facts are narrow

BSC knows transactions, program state, your token balance if you hold any, gas paid in BNB. It does not know grade of ore, honesty of an assay, a judge’s order, a tenant, a pipeline, whether a PDF was true on Thursday. Oracles inherit their inputs. If the oracle is the team, you have a blog with extra steps. Pictures on IPFS are pictures.

lessons.title: Impersonation playbook for this logo
lessons.content:
# Impersonation playbook for this logo

Crystal logos are easy to steal. Your keys are not.

## Five plays

1. **Clone academy.** Slightly wrong domain, Google login lookalike, “session expired, resubmit seed.”
2.** CST or random network, address from a chat.
3. **Clone Mentor.** “I am Crystal Mentor, send CST to analyse your wallet.”
4. **Clone support.** “Your Intermediate payment is stuck, remote desktop.”
5. **Clone RWA portal.** “Connect to see vault cameras.”

Real academy: bookmarked origin, password or real OAuth, USDT BEP-20 order, Mentor that cannot take tokens, no remote desktop, no vault cameras as a product.

## Worked scenario

OAuth popup. URL is not Google and not your academy. You close. You do not “just this once.” Certificate QR going to localhost means someone printed before production env was set — engineering bug, not a reason to type a seed.

DIAGRAM
LOGO --> untrusted
ORIGIN YOU TYPED --> trusted
Always the origin, never the sticker.
ENDDIAGRAM

NOTE
Report impersonators. Do not duel them with test transactions.
ENDNOTE

## Threat model for this token (PDF Lesson 5)

Fake contracts using the same name. Defense: contract tattooed on paper and compared every time (`0xe252FCb1Aa2E0876E9B5f3eD1e15B9b4d11A0b00`).

Poisoned swap links in replies under official posts. Defense: type pancakeswap.finance yourself or use the link on crystalstones.org. A Discord “mod” sending a PancakeSwap link with a different outputCurrency is a stop.

Approval drainers. A site asks you to “verify wallet” or “claim airdrop.” You sign approve for unlimited tokens or WBNB to an unknown spender. Defense: never sign approve except to the router you intended, and revoke unused approvals later.

Wrong network. Token on BSC; you are on Ethereum, Base, or a wallet’s default. Defense: chain ID 56 before every signature. Pasting this BSC contract on Ethereum Mainnet is how people send value into nothing useful — or into a clone.

Seed-phrase theater. Anyone asking for 12/24 words to “whitelist you for the CEX” or “sync the academy” is stealing the wallet. The academy never needs your seed. Token-gating, if it ever appears, is a read or signature event. It still does not require a seed.

Tax-blind slippage. Failed swaps drive people into “helper” dApps that are drainers.

Support impersonation. Official contacts: info@crystalstones.org, t.me/crystalstones, @crystalstones01, discord.gg/crystalstones. Support will not DM first asking you to seed a wallet or pay a “release fee.”

Old-contract / migration traps. The 44% migrated line is why scammers keep old addresses alive.

lessons.title: Never-list on paper — Crystal edition
lessons.content:
# Never-list on paper — Crystal edition

Write it. Put it away from the seed.

1. Seed, private key, 2FA, remote control.
2. CST as tuition or as “unlock Intermediate.”
3. Pay the token contract, a lookalike 0x, or a chat paste.
4. Connect wallet to see backing, cameras, or certificates.
5. Rank NFTs, rescue migrations, sequel tickers that need a signature today.
6. Price targets “from academy staff.”
7. Certificates as title to minerals, land, or oil.
8. Admin access sold as a token.

## Do list

 Date-stamp supply. Four drawers for claims. USDT BEP-20 for Intermediate. Quizzes for XP.

## Worked scenario

You are drunk on a win from a quiz streak. A DM congratulates you and offers a CST bonus. Never-list item 4 and 6. Close. Sleep. The streak is already in the database.

DIAGRAM
PAPER <-- handwriting
PHONE <-- phishing
Do not photograph the never-list next to your seed card.
ENDDIAGRAM

## Holding hygiene

Seed or hardware key offline. Phone wallet is fine for small balances; it is not a vault. Separate hot wallet (swap) from cold wallet (hold) once the size would hurt to lose. After a swap, check BscScan token page against your address. Confirm you received the token from the pair, not from a random minter. If you use the on-site swap widget, still verify the destination contract in the wallet confirmation — widgets can be cloned.

Connecting a wallet to crystalweb3academy.org, if the product later uses token-gating, is a read or signature. Read the domain letter-by-letter. A hyphenated clone is the oldest trick in this category.

## Incident drill

You signed something you did not understand. Do not send more funds. Move unapproved assets from a new wallet if the key may be burned. Revoke approvals from a known revoker only if the key is still yours and you understand the transaction. Assume the old hot wallet is dirty.

lessons.title: Do not become unpaid investor relations
lessons.content:
# Do not become unpaid investor relations

Literate graduates sometimes turn into megaphones. That helps someone else’s chart, not your exam.

## Allowed

“Here is the contract I verify.” “Backing is a claim.” “I studied at the academy.”

## Not allowed as if it were class

“We going to X price.” “Guaranteed minerals.” “I am staff.” “Send to this 0x, I will enroll you.”

You are not staff because you finished Intermediate. Staff have a role in a database and, for admin, extra friction. They still will not DM 0x.

## Worked scenario

A group asks you to drop “the payment address. Sharing one address with a group is how people pay the wrong order.

DIAGRAM
THEIR ACCOUNT --> THEIR ORDER --> THEIR ADDRESS
Your memory of an old invoice is hostile. It may be expired or someone else's.
ENDDIAGRAM

NOTE
Helping a friend sit next to them while they use their own login is kindness. Pasting addresses is not.
ENDNOTE

## Education voice

Allowed: “Here is the contract I verify.” “Here is how a PancakeSwap path is checked.” “Backing is a claim.” “I studied at the academy.”

Not allowed as if it were class: price choir, guaranteed minerals, “I am staff,” “send to this 0x, I will enroll you.” You are not staff because you finished Intermediate. Staff have a role in a database. They still will not DM 0x.

lessons.title: After Intermediate
lessons.content:
# After Intermediate

You have rails, a BEP-20 method, an RWA method, and a never-list. Advanced will be video when the client ships video. It will not replace the never-list.

## Do not wait for

A hymn. A vault livestream as a substitute for documents. A CST discount on tuition. Staff in your DMs. A rank sale.

## You can

Re-read supply when you care. Keep bookmarks. Finish any locked courses honestly, or use an admin preview only on your own machine for editing content — not as a product for the world.

## Worked scenario

You are tempted to skip remaining Intermediate courses because this one felt like the “real” one. It is the brand course. Tokenomics and DeFi still pay the $10. Go back if you skipped with holes.

DIAGRAM
BASIC literacy --> INTERMEDIATE methods --> (later) ADVANCED video
CST balance is not a prerequisite on any arrow.
ENDDIAGRAM

NOTE
If you used SQL to unlock courses to edit them, that is a studio tool. Learners still sequence. Do not ship your unlocked account as policy.
ENDNOTE

## Incoming versus live

Live path today, per the site: wallet → BNB on BNB Smart Chain → PancakeSwap (and the on-site swap widget). A card on-ramp (Transak) is shown as a fiat path into the same destination. CEX names on the page are marked incoming. Do not search “Crystal Stones” on a major CEX and buy the first ticker you see — ticker collision is a standard scam. If a third site lists Binance as a venue but crystalstones.org says incoming, you follow the official page.

Advanced will be video when it ships. It will not replace the never-list. CST balance is not a prerequisite on any arrow in this curriculum.

lessons.title: The ecosystem memo
lessons.content:
# The ecosystem memo

One page.

- Token facts dated.

- Claims quoted plus blanks.
- Never-list reference.
- “Education only. Not a buy.”

Print. If it would embarrass you in another country, it is still too hymnal. Cut.

DIAGRAM
PAGE
  token
  school
  claims/blanks
  never
  no buy
ENDDIAGRAM

NOTE
A second page of price charts is not a memo. It is a poster. Recycle it.
ENDNOTE

## One page, five boxes

A token facts dated (supply, taxes 3/6/0.2, lock and renounce as stated — checked or blank). B sleeves quoted plus what finish would require. C live academy. D incoming CEX/chain. E listings/audit — what they prove and what they do not. Never-list reference. “Education only. Not a buy.” If it would embarrass you in another country, it is still too hymnal. Cut. A second page of price charts is a poster. Recycle it.

lessons.title: Refuse five impersonations
lessons.content:
# Refuse five impersonations

Practice out loud.

1. “Connect to see the vault.” — No. Explorers read without connect. Vaults are not a connect wall.
2. “Send CST to the contract to sync Intermediate.” — No.
3. “Remote desktop, payment stuck.” — No. Hash to real support.
4. “Seed to map certificate on-chain.” — No. Certificates are school records.
5. “New domain today, migrate.” — No. Calm-day bookmark.

If you hesitated, write them on the never-list again.

DIAGRAM
PROMPT --> REFUSAL SENTENCE --> HANDS OFF WALLET
ENDDIAGRAM

NOTE
Politeness is optional. Refusals are not.
ENDNOTE

## Out loud, then hands off

1. “Connect to see the vault.” Explorers read without connect. 2. PancakeSwap GIF with outputCurrency ≠ `0xe252FCb1Aa2E0876E9B5f3eD1e15B9b4d11A0b00`. Stop. 3. “Remote desktop, payment stuck.” No. 4. “Seed to whitelist the CEX / sync the academy.” No. 5. “New domain today, migrate” or old-contract “official.” Calm-day bookmark; current contract only.

lessons.title: Close

# Close

You are not a fund. You are not the warehouse. You are not unpaid IR. You are a learner who can keep three sentences and a never-list.

The $10 was for that, plus the rest of Intermediate’s machinery. If a module was thin before, this course was rewritten to be mechanisms. If something is still wrong, send the module title and the failure — “too hymnal,” “stale number,” “mash-up.” Do not send “make it punchier.” Punch is how hymns start.

Finish the quiz. Then go correct other courses with the same standard.

DIAGRAM
THREE SENTENCES
FOUR DRAWERS
EIGHT NEVERS

ENDDIAGRAM

Powered by Crystal Stones. Educated by you. Not a buy signal.
ENDNOTE

Screenshot your BscScan token-add (or token page) with the official contract visible. No balances required. Source of record for numbers: crystalstones.org tokenomics block and buy flow as published September 2026.

You are not a fund, a warehouse, or unpaid IR. You can keep layers, a tax table, a pair address, and a threat model. Neither course tells you to buy. Public figures in this course are from crystalstones.org as reviewed September 2026. Re-date them when you write.
